submitted.rationale: Index 6 (Sb 0.255) had the highest EQE of the five measured, at 0.040%. Every value was tiny and index 13 read negative, so noise is about the same size as the signal and the ranking is weak. The Sb-rich side, around the CrSbO4 rutile and Sb-rich rutile alloys, gave 0.01–0.02%. The Cr-rich side is barely sampled, so the true best may lie between Sb 0.14 and 0.35.
